prose: AMD has agreed to acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion in an all-stock deal, per the headline of this story. The original source could not be retrieved, so deal terms beyond the headline are unverified here; however, World Labs' own announcement (covered separately) confirms a definitive agreement to join AMD, closing expected by end of 2026, with Li becoming AMD Executive VP and Chief Scientist under Lisa Su and the team continuing as a frontier research organization inside AMD.
highlights: Headline: AMD to acquire World Labs for $8.2B in an all-stock deal
The source could not be fetched, so terms beyond the headline are unverified
World Labs' own post confirms a definitive agreement, closing expected by end of 2026
Li joins AMD as EVP and Chief Scientist reporting to Lisa Su
